choices.candidate: Preserve effective v2 schema and full-body hashing. Reconcile M04 observations to frozen server-resolved body. Save purpose is immutable held-pin issuer-record binding, not a new transfer body field; changed valid body conflicts, changed source binding fails proof verification.

choices.gap: store_identity/native target identity are prose; no issuer authentication, alias-safe identity/fence validator, durable inclusion verifier or restart implementation exists.
choices.candidate: Approve exact native issuer lookup/fence/inclusion seams and failure contract before Skeleton. Document fixture membership is only an assumed lookup.

choices.gap: Closed transfer-formal request is already defined by central v3 schema. TransferReceipt and registry projection need exact M04 handoff/output mapping; pin/receipt UUID lineage and semantic profile mapping remain handoff questions, not a reopening of v3 hash closure.
choices.candidate: Reuse central closed request; choose exact issuer registry to M04 response/proof mapping without inventing fields or treating prose projection as adopted runtime response.

choices.gap: Uncertain CAS and after-CAS raw proof loss cannot prove prior or committed state from response absence. Record raw digest cannot self-reference its own committed index.
choices.candidate: Record logical generation in same CAS; retain external four-field commit proof separately as issuer evidence. No new registry; explicit reconciliation revalidates raw bytes and inclusion, never auto retry/ACK/release.
